models.name: Employee scheduling
models.summary: Assigns employees to shifts across a roster: skills, availability, rest between shifts, contracts, fairness and preferences.

demos.name: A month of shifts
demos.summary: 50 employees and 536 shifts from 28 February to 29 March 2027, under three contracts.

columns.name: kind
columns.label: Rule
options: Shifts next to a day off

columns.name: linkMinutes
columns.label: Shifts this close are one run

constraints.name: Mandatory shift left open
constraints.description: A mandatory shift inside the schedule has no employee; costs its importance.

constraints.name: Optional shift left open
constraints.description: An optional shift inside the schedule has no employee; costs its importance.

constraints.name: Required skill lacking
constraints.description: The employee does not hold, at the required level and at the shift start, a skill the shift requires.

constraints.name: Preferred skill lacking
constraints.description: The employee does not hold a skill the shift would like its employee to have.

constraints.name: Prohibited risk exposure
constraints.description: The shift exposes the employee to a risk factor they must avoid.

constraints.name: Works while unavailable
constraints.description: Minutes of a shift fall inside a time the employee cannot work.

constraints.name: Works outside available hours
constraints.description: Minutes of a shift fall outside the only times the employee said they can work.

constraints.name: Works in preferred hours
constraints.description: Rewards minutes of a shift inside a time the employee would like to work.

constraints.name: Works in unwanted hours
constraints.description: Minutes of a shift fall inside a time the employee would rather not work.

constraints.name: Preferred employee on shift
constraints.description: Rewards a shift worked by one of the employees it prefers.

constraints.name: Unwanted employee on shift
constraints.description: A shift is worked by an employee it would rather not have.

constraints.name: Barred employee on shift
constraints.description: A shift is worked by an employee it bars.

constraints.name: Shift outside employee's required tags
constraints.description: An employee who only works certain shifts is given another kind.

constraints.name: Shift has employee's preferred tags
constraints.description: Rewards a shift of a kind the employee likes.

constraints.name: Travel distance over limit
constraints.description: A shift lies further from the employee's home than a travel rule allows; costs the excess kilometres.

constraints.name: Travel distance
constraints.description: Kilometres from each employee's home to their shift, to keep travel short.

constraints.name: Minutes per period outside required range
constraints.description: Minutes worked in a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Minutes per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: Minutes worked in a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Minutes in rolling window outside required range
constraints.description: Minutes worked in a rolling window is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Minutes in rolling window outside preferred range
constraints.description: Minutes worked in a rolling window is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Logged minutes per period outside required range
constraints.description: Logged minutes in a period, including minutes logged before the data, is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Logged minutes per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: Logged minutes in a period, including minutes logged before the data, is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Days worked per period outside required range
constraints.description: The number of days worked in a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Days worked per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: The number of days worked in a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Days worked in rolling window outside required range
constraints.description: The number of days worked in a rolling window is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Days worked in rolling window outside preferred range
constraints.description: The number of days worked in a rolling window is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Employee shifts per period outside required range
constraints.description: An employee's shift count in a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Employee shifts per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: An employee's shift count in a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Employee shifts in rolling window outside required range
constraints.description: An employee's shift count in a rolling window is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Employee shifts in rolling window outside preferred range
constraints.description: An employee's shift count in a rolling window is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Weekends worked per period outside required range
constraints.description: The number of weekends worked in a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Weekends worked per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: The number of weekends worked in a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Weekends worked in rolling window outside required range
constraints.description: The number of weekends worked in a rolling window is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Weekends worked in rolling window outside preferred range
constraints.description: The number of weekends worked in a rolling window is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Weekend minutes per period outside required range
constraints.description: Minutes worked on weekend days in a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Weekend minutes per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: Minutes worked on weekend days in a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive weekends worked outside required range
constraints.description: A run of worked weekends inside a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive weekends worked outside preferred range
constraints.description: A run of worked weekends inside a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive days worked outside required range
constraints.description: A run of consecutive worked days is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive days worked outside preferred range
constraints.description: A run of consecutive worked days is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive shifts outside required range
constraints.description: A run of shifts close together is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive shifts outside preferred range
constraints.description: A run of shifts close together is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Rest after a run of shifts below required minimum
constraints.description: After a long enough run of shifts the employee gets fewer minutes off than required; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Rest after a run of shifts below preferred minimum
constraints.description: After a long enough run of shifts the employee gets fewer minutes off than preferred; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Gap between differing runs below required minimum
constraints.description: A run of one shift category follows a run of another too soon; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Gap between differing runs below preferred minimum
constraints.description: A run of one shift category follows a run of another sooner than preferred; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Run starts on a disallowed day
constraints.description: A run of worked days starts on a weekday a required rule does not allow.

constraints.name: Run starts on an allowed day
constraints.description: Rewards each run of worked days that starts on a weekday a preferred rule allows.

constraints.name: Run ends on a start day
constraints.description: A run of worked days ends on a weekday reserved for starting runs.

constraints.name: Compact run of one category
constraints.description: Rewards each day that continues the previous day's shift category within a run.

constraints.name: Days off per period outside required range
constraints.description: The number of days off in a period is outside a required contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Days off per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: The number of days off in a period is outside a preferred contract range; costs the distance outside it times rule weight and employee priority.

constraints.name: Consecutive days off per period below required minimum
constraints.description: The longest run of days off in a period is shorter than required; costs the missing days.

constraints.name: Consecutive days off per period below preferred minimum
constraints.description: The longest run of days off in a period is shorter than preferred; costs the missing days.

constraints.name: Consecutive days off in rolling window below required minimum
constraints.description: The longest run of days off in a rolling window is shorter than required; costs the missing days.

constraints.name: Consecutive days off in rolling window below preferred minimum
constraints.description: The longest run of days off in a rolling window is shorter than preferred; costs the missing days.

constraints.name: Continuous rest in rolling window below required minimum
constraints.description: The longest stretch without work in a rolling window is shorter than required; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Continuous rest in rolling window below preferred minimum
constraints.description: The longest stretch without work in a rolling window is shorter than preferred; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Consecutive weekends off per period below required minimum
constraints.description: The longest run of weekends off in a period is shorter than required; costs the missing weekends.

constraints.name: Consecutive weekends off per period below preferred minimum
constraints.description: The longest run of weekends off in a period is shorter than preferred; costs the missing weekends.

constraints.name: Barred shift next to a requested day off
constraints.description: A shift a contract bars lands on the day before or after a requested day off.

constraints.name: Unwanted shift next to a requested day off
constraints.description: A shift a contract dislikes lands on the day before or after a requested day off.

constraints.name: Overlapping shifts
constraints.description: Minutes in which two shifts of one employee overlap, unless a contract allows both to overlap.

constraints.name: Rest between shifts outside required range
constraints.description: The minutes from one shift's end to the employee's next shift are outside a required range; costs the distance.

constraints.name: Rest between shifts outside preferred range
constraints.description: The minutes from one shift's end to the employee's next shift are outside a preferred range; costs the distance.

constraints.name: Start time spread per period outside required range
constraints.description: The earliest and latest start times of day in a period lie further apart than required; costs the excess minutes.

constraints.name: Start time spread per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: The earliest and latest start times of day in a period lie further apart than preferred; costs the excess minutes.

constraints.name: Split shifts close together
constraints.description: Rewards successive shifts of a split day for every minute their gap stays under the largest allowed gap.

constraints.name: Required shift pairing missing
constraints.description: A shift that must come with a paired shift on a set day lacks it.

constraints.name: Preferred shift pairing missing
constraints.description: A shift that should come with a paired shift on a set day lacks it.

constraints.name: Barred shift pairing worked
constraints.description: A shift is worked together with a paired shift it must never go with.

constraints.name: Unwanted shift pairing worked
constraints.description: A shift is worked together with a paired shift it should not go with.

constraints.name: Required day pattern broken
constraints.description: A day has shifts of a required single-day pattern without completing the pattern.

constraints.name: Preferred day pattern worked
constraints.description: Rewards each day whose shifts complete a preferred single-day pattern.

constraints.name: Barred day pattern worked
constraints.description: A day's shifts complete a barred single-day pattern.

constraints.name: Unwanted day pattern worked
constraints.description: A day's shifts complete an unwanted single-day pattern.

constraints.name: Required multi-day pattern broken
constraints.description: A run of days starts like a required multi-day pattern but does not follow it.

constraints.name: Preferred multi-day pattern worked
constraints.description: Rewards each run of days that follows a preferred multi-day pattern.

constraints.name: Barred multi-day pattern worked
constraints.description: A run of days follows a barred multi-day pattern.

constraints.name: Unwanted multi-day pattern worked
constraints.description: A run of days follows an unwanted multi-day pattern.

constraints.name: Required weekly rotation broken
constraints.description: A week mixes rotation groups or does not move on to the next group, against a required rotation.

constraints.name: Preferred weekly rotation broken
constraints.description: A week mixes rotation groups or does not move on to the next group, against a preferred rotation.

constraints.name: Rotation block longer than required maximum
constraints.description: A block of days in one rotation group runs longer than required; costs the extra days.

constraints.name: Rotation block length outside preferred range
constraints.description: A block of days in one rotation group is shorter or longer than preferred; costs the distance.

constraints.name: Shift types per period outside required range
constraints.description: The shifts of a category an employee works in a period fall outside a required range; costs the distance per category.

constraints.name: Shift types per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: The shifts of a category an employee works in a period fall outside a preferred range; costs the distance per category.

constraints.name: Distinct tags per period for employee outside required range
constraints.description: An employee works more (or fewer) distinct tags of some types in a period than required.

constraints.name: Distinct tags per period for employee outside preferred range
constraints.description: An employee works more (or fewer) distinct tags of some types in a period than preferred.

constraints.name: Too little time to change location
constraints.description: Successive shifts at different locations leave less time between them than required; costs the missing minutes.

constraints.name: Locations per period outside required range
constraints.description: An employee works at more (or fewer) distinct locations in a period than required.

constraints.name: Locations per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: An employee works at more (or fewer) distinct locations in a period than preferred.

constraints.name: Contract cost outside required range
constraints.description: An employee's pay for a period, overtime tiers included, falls outside a required range; costs the distance in cents.

constraints.name: Contract cost
constraints.description: An employee's pay for a period, overtime tiers included, in cents (or its distance from a preferred range).

constraints.name: Employee activated
constraints.description: An employee works at least one shift, at their cost group's activation cost.

constraints.name: Activated employee filled up
constraints.description: Rewards the square of the shifts worked by employees of fill-up cost groups, so work concentrates on fewer people.

constraints.name: Uneven shift counts
constraints.description: The square of each employee's shift count (history included) under a fairness rule, so shifts spread evenly.

constraints.name: Uneven time worked
constraints.description: The square of each employee's hours (history included) under a fairness rule, so time worked spreads evenly.

constraints.name: Published shifts lost by employee
constraints.description: An employee loses shifts published to them, times their priority.

constraints.name: Unpublished shifts gained by employee
constraints.description: An employee gets shifts that were not published to them, times their priority.

constraints.name: Gained shifts keep tags of lost ones
constraints.description: Rewards each tag a gained shift shares with a shift the employee lost.

constraints.name: Close replacements keep rule tags
constraints.description: Rewards each rule tag a close replacement keeps from the shift it replaces.

constraints.name: Lost shift without required close replacement
constraints.description: An employee loses a shift in a required disruption rule's scope with no close replacement.

constraints.name: Lost shift without preferred close replacement
constraints.description: An employee loses a shift in a preferred disruption rule's scope with no close replacement.

constraints.name: Concurrent shifts over limit
constraints.description: More matching shifts run at once than a concurrency rule allows; costs the excess at each shift start.

constraints.name: Required partner absent
constraints.description: An employee works a shift without the colleague they must work with at the same time.

constraints.name: Preferred partner present
constraints.description: Rewards a shift during which a colleague the employee likes to work with also works.

constraints.name: Unwanted partner present
constraints.description: An employee works a shift at the same time as a colleague they would rather avoid.

constraints.name: Barred partner present
constraints.description: An employee works a shift at the same time as a colleague they must never work with.

constraints.name: Team members split across tags
constraints.description: Two team members work at the same time on shifts sharing no tag of the team's tag type.

constraints.name: Team member without a lead
constraints.description: A team member who is not a lead works a shift with no team lead working at the same time.

constraints.name: Team lead works with the team
constraints.description: Rewards a team lead's shift during which another team member also works.

constraints.name: Team shifts per day over limit
constraints.description: A team spreads one tag's work over more distinct shift times in a day than allowed.

constraints.name: Required demand under-staffed
constraints.description: A required demand slot has fewer covering staff than its minimum; costs each missing person.

constraints.name: Required demand over-staffed
constraints.description: A required demand slot has more covering staff than its maximum; costs each extra person.

constraints.name: Preferred demand under-staffed
constraints.description: A preferred demand slot has fewer covering staff than its minimum; costs each missing person.

constraints.name: Preferred demand over-staffed
constraints.description: A preferred demand slot has more covering staff than its maximum; costs each extra person.

constraints.name: Surplus staff unevenly spread over demand
constraints.description: The square of the staff beyond each slot's minimum, so surplus spreads evenly over the day.

constraints.name: Shift count per period outside required range
constraints.description: Assigned matching shifts across all employees in a period fall outside a required range; costs the distance.

constraints.name: Shift count per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: Assigned matching shifts across all employees in a period fall outside a preferred range; costs the distance.

constraints.name: Distinct tags per period across schedule outside required range
constraints.description: All assigned shifts of a period staff more (or fewer) distinct tags of some types than required.

constraints.name: Distinct tags per period across schedule outside preferred range
constraints.description: All assigned shifts of a period staff more (or fewer) distinct tags of some types than preferred.

constraints.name: Cost per period outside required range
constraints.description: The pay of matching assignments across employees in a period falls outside a required range; costs the distance in cents.

constraints.name: Cost per period outside preferred range
constraints.description: The pay of matching assignments across employees in a period falls outside a preferred range; costs the distance in cents.

constraints.name: Cost per period
constraints.description: The pay of matching assignments across employees in a period, in cents, to keep it low.

constraints.name: Alternative shifts worked off count
constraints.description: A group of alternative shifts has more (or fewer) of its versions worked than asked.

constraints.name: Activated employees off target share
constraints.description: Activated employees per cost group stray from the groups' target shares; costs each employee off target.

constraints.name: Published assignment changed
constraints.description: A shift no longer goes to the employee it was published to.

models.name: Task scheduling
models.summary: Orders jobs on machines and people: dependencies, skills, changeovers, availability, due dates and the length of the schedule.

demos.name: Factory week
demos.summary: 409 tasks on 24 machines and people over a week in March 2027, with changeovers and due dates.

parameters.name: defaultPriority
parameters.label: Default priority
parameters.description: Priority of a task that sets none; priorities weigh unassigned tasks, ideal ends and resources outside a task's list.

parameters.name: interruptible
parameters.label: Tasks pause over breaks
parameters.description: Whether a task pauses over its resource's unavailable spans and continues afterwards, unless the task sets noInterruptions; when false, tasks wait for a gap long enough to run whole.

parameters.name: brokenLinkPenalty
parameters.label: Cost of a broken link
parameters.description: Hard cost of one broken structural link: a dependency left unassigned, split across resources, interrupted by other tasks, or handed over on a forbidden transition.

constraints.name: Started before earliest start
constraints.description: A task (pinned at a fixed start) starts before its earliest start; costs the minutes it is early.

constraints.name: Finished after deadline
constraints.description: A task ends after its deadline; costs the minutes it overruns.

constraints.name: Dependency left unassigned
constraints.description: A task is planned while a task it depends on is left unassigned; costs the broken-link penalty.

constraints.name: Dependency offset broken
constraints.description: A task starts outside the offsets its dependency allows after the preceding task's end or start; costs the minutes outside. A task that cannot be timed, because it waits on a task queued after it on its resource or follows one that does, costs the broken-link penalty.

constraints.name: Dependency split across resources
constraints.description: Two dependent tasks that must share a resource run on different ones; costs the broken-link penalty.

constraints.name: Dependency interrupted by other tasks
constraints.description: Other tasks run between two dependent tasks that must follow each other directly; costs the broken-link penalty per task in between.

constraints.name: Required tag missing
constraints.description: A task runs on a resource that lacks a required tag, or holds it only part of the time; costs the minutes not covered.

constraints.name: Resource not allowed
constraints.description: A task runs on a resource outside its required resources; costs the task's priority.

constraints.name: Forbidden resource hand-over
constraints.description: A task runs on a resource its preceding task may not hand over to from its own; costs the broken-link penalty.

constraints.name: Parts out of stock
constraints.description: A task starts while the stock lacks parts it uses up: what was on hand or has arrived, plus what tasks that ended made, less what tasks that started took; costs one hour per unit short.

constraints.name: Task left unassigned
constraints.description: A task is left unassigned; costs its priority, so the most important tasks are planned first.

constraints.name: Makespan
constraints.description: The longest time any resource takes from its start to the end of its last task, in minutes.

constraints.name: Distance from ideal end
constraints.description: A task ends before or after its ideal end; costs the minutes off times its priority.

constraints.name: Lateness after due date
constraints.description: A task ends after its due date; costs the minutes late.

constraints.name: Changeover time
constraints.description: A machine spends setup time switching task types between consecutive tasks; costs the setup minutes.

constraints.name: Changeover count
constraints.description: A machine switches task type, or sets up between consecutive tasks; costs one per changeover.

constraints.name: Machine idle time
constraints.description: A machine waits before a task without working, changing over or being unavailable; costs the idle minutes (off unless weighted).

constraints.name: Preferred resource hand-over
constraints.description: A task runs on a resource its preceding task's resource prefers to hand over to; earns the hand-over's reward.

models.name: Pick-up and delivery routing
models.summary: Routes drivers through pick-ups and drop-offs made in pairs: vehicle capacity, time windows, skills, shift limits and breaks.

demos.name: Milan, two days
demos.summary: 15 drivers on 30 shifts and 155 jobs around Milan over two days, each job a pick-up and a drop-off.

columns.name: maxSoftLastStopDepartureTime
columns.label: Should leave the last stop by

columns.name: pinned
columns.label: Keep the route as it is

columns.name: pinNextStopDuringFreeze
columns.label: Keep the next stop when replanning

columns.name: minStartTravelTime
columns.label: Set off towards it no earlier than

parameters.name: defaultPriority
parameters.label: Default priority
parameters.description: Priority of a job that sets none: 1 to 10 are mandatory, opt-1 to opt-10 optional, each level ten times the weight of the next.

parameters.name: maximumTimeBurden
parameters.label: Longest added ride time
parameters.description: Minutes pooling may add to a job's ride beyond direct service, for jobs that set none; unset means no limit.

parameters.name: pinNextStopDuringFreeze
parameters.label: Freezing pins the next stop
parameters.description: Freezing the past also pins the stop each driver is on the way to; a shift may override it.

constraints.name: Ride past a destination
constraints.description: The vehicle serves another stop at a job's next destination while the job is on board, without dropping it off; costs one hour per pass.

constraints.name: Vehicle capacity exceeded
constraints.description: The load on board after a stop exceeds the vehicle's capacity of a type; costs one hour per unit over, per stop and type.

constraints.name: Preferred driver not assigned
constraints.description: A stop's job prefers other drivers than the one serving it; costs one per stop.

constraints.name: Driver not among the required
constraints.description: A stop is served by a driver its job does not list among its required drivers; costs one hour per stop.

constraints.name: Prohibited driver assigned
constraints.description: A stop is served by a driver its job prohibits; costs one hour per stop.

constraints.name: Time burden over the maximum
constraints.description: Pooling makes a job's ride longer than direct service plus its maximum time burden; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Prohibited jobs on board together
constraints.description: Two jobs where one prohibits the other are on board at the same time; costs the seconds together.

constraints.name: Pooled with a job that forbids pooling
constraints.description: A job that forbids pooling is on board together with another job; costs the seconds together.

constraints.name: Required tags missing
constraints.description: The shift serving a stop lacks tags its job requires; costs one hour per missing tag.

constraints.name: Parts out of stock
constraints.description: A stop needs parts its shift's stock no longer holds when it is served, its earlier stops having used them; costs one hour per unit short.

constraints.name: Floating break ends too late
constraints.description: A floating break ends after its latest end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Late for a fixed break
constraints.description: Work runs into a fixed break, which starts late; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Late for an appointment
constraints.description: The driver reaches a fixed break at a place of its own after it starts; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Fixed break while a job is on board
constraints.description: A fixed break falls while a job is on board, and the job or the break forbids it; costs the break seconds.

constraints.name: Floating break while a job is on board
constraints.description: A floating break falls while a job is on board, and the job or the break forbids it; costs the break seconds.

constraints.name: Stop later than its earliest day
constraints.description: A stop whose windows span several days is served after the first day a shift that may serve it works; costs 1000 per day later.

constraints.name: Mandatory stop unplanned
constraints.description: A stop of a mandatory job is unplanned; costs its priority weight.

constraints.name: Optional stop unplanned
constraints.description: A stop of an optional job is unplanned; costs its priority weight.

constraints.name: Pinned stop off its shift
constraints.description: A pinned stop is not on the shift it is pinned to; costs 10 000 000 000.

constraints.name: Pinned stop starts late
constraints.description: A pinned stop starts after the start it keeps; costs 100 000 per second late.

constraints.name: Waiting time
constraints.description: A driver waits before starting service, for a window to open; costs the seconds. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Stop unreachable from the previous place
constraints.description: No road leads to a stop or break from the place before it; costs one hour per visit.

constraints.name: SLA missed
constraints.description: A stop ends after its latest SLA end, or stays unplanned with that SLA inside the planning window; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Required skills missing
constraints.description: The shift serving a stop lacks a skill its job requires, or holds it below the required level; costs one hour per missing skill and per level short.

constraints.name: Driver more skilled than needed
constraints.description: The shift serving a stop holds skills above the level its job requires; costs the service seconds times the levels above.

constraints.name: Service ends after its window
constraints.description: A stop's service ends after its window's latest end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Service starts after its window
constraints.description: A stop's service starts after its window's latest start; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Stop served before the stop it follows
constraints.description: A stop starts before the job's previous stop has left; costs the seconds of overlap, or the previous stop's service seconds when it is unplanned, plus one hour.

constraints.name: Job split across shifts
constraints.description: A job's stop is planned on another shift than the job's previous stop; costs the stop's service seconds plus one hour.

constraints.name: Stop planned while the stop before it is not
constraints.description: A stop is planned while the job's previous stop is unplanned; costs the service seconds of both plus one hour.

constraints.name: Job partly planned
constraints.description: Some stops of a job are planned and others are not; costs the service seconds of each unplanned one plus one hour.

constraints.name: Driver used
constraints.description: A driver serves at least one stop in the plan; costs one hour per driver, so fewer drivers do the work. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Work unbalanced between drivers
constraints.description: Drivers work different amounts: each driver's working minutes, start to end over all their shifts, squared; costs the sum, which is least when work is shared evenly. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Unreachable leg in a route
constraints.description: A shift's route has a leg no road connects, from its start through its stops and breaks to its end; costs one hour per leg.

constraints.name: Travel time
constraints.description: Driving time of a shift, from its start through its stops to its end; costs the seconds.

constraints.name: Last stop departs after the latest time
constraints.description: A shift leaves its last stop after the latest departure; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Shift ends after the latest time
constraints.description: A shift reaches its end location after its latest end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Last stop departs after the preferred time
constraints.description: A shift leaves its last stop after the preferred departure; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Shift ends after the preferred time
constraints.description: A shift reaches its end location after its preferred end; costs the seconds of overtime.

models.name: Field service routing
models.summary: Routes technicians and their vans through customer visits over several days: skills, time windows, linked and multi-technician visits, breaks and overtime.

demos.name: Turin, two days
demos.summary: 30 technicians on 60 shifts and 223 visits around Turin and Aosta, with linked visits, lunch breaks and a two-day lift job in the Aosta valley.

parameters.name: defaultPriority
parameters.label: Default priority
parameters.description: Priority of a visit that sets none: 1 to 10 are mandatory, opt-1 to opt-10 optional, each level ten times the weight of the next.

parameters.name: durationAddedForFirstVisitOnLocation
parameters.label: Arrival time at a new place
parameters.description: Minutes added to a visit when the item before it was elsewhere (parking, check-in), for visits that set none.

parameters.name: visitCompletionRiskMinimalTimeToShiftEnd
parameters.label: Risky time before a shift ends
parameters.description: Minutes before a shift's end within which an important visit risks not being completed.

parameters.name: visitCompletionRiskMinimalPriority
parameters.label: Least priority at risk
parameters.description: Least important priority whose visits carry completion risk.

parameters.name: defaultTechnicianRating
parameters.label: Default technician rating
parameters.description: Rating of a technician who has none.

parameters.name: travelTimeAdjustment
parameters.label: Travel time adjustment
parameters.description: Every drive takes multiplier times the drive on the roads plus extraTime minutes, for shifts that set none.

parameters.name: preferGroupingColocatedVisitsRadiusMeters
parameters.label: Same-place radius
parameters.description: Two consecutive items closer than this many meters count as one place for co-located grouping; at most 200.

parameters.name: defaultDependencyPoolingType
parameters.label: What may run inside a dependency
parameters.description: What may run between a preceding visit and the visit waiting on it, for dependencies that set none.
options: Nothing: the visit follows right away

parameters.name: pinnedStartAllowedDelay
parameters.label: Allowed delay of a pinned visit
parameters.description: Minutes a pinned visit may start after its kept start at a soft cost; later costs hard.

parameters.name: holidays
parameters.label: Holidays
parameters.description: Dates that are no working day for dependencies delayed to the next working day.

parameters.name: pinNextVisitDuringFreeze
parameters.label: Freezing pins the next visit
parameters.description: Freezing the past also pins the visit each technician is on the way to; a shift may override it.

constraints.name: Require visit dependency delay
constraints.description: A visit starts later than its dependency allows after the preceding visit departs; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Require the same vehicle for dependent visit
constraints.description: A visit is served by another vehicle than the visit it depends on, which must share it; costs its service seconds plus one hour.

constraints.name: Require the same vehicle shift for dependent visit
constraints.description: A visit is served on another shift than the visit it depends on, which must share it; costs its service seconds plus one hour.

constraints.name: Require visit dependency prerequisite assigned
constraints.description: A visit is planned while a visit it depends on is not; costs its service seconds plus one hour.

constraints.name: Require visit dependency pooling type
constraints.description: The visit served right before a dependent visit is one its dependency's pooling type rules out; costs one hour.

constraints.name: Fixed break not delayed (hard)
constraints.description: The technician reaches a fixed break at a place of its own after it starts; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Max floating break end time (hard)
constraints.description: A floating break ends after its latest end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: No conflict with fixed break
constraints.description: Work runs into a fixed break, which starts late; costs the seconds of overlap.

constraints.name: No conflict with fixed location break
constraints.description: Work runs into a fixed break at a place of its own; costs the seconds of overlap.

constraints.name: Prefer visits scheduled to the earliest day
constraints.description: A movable visit is served after the first day a technician who may serve it works; costs 1000 per day later.

constraints.name: Minimize the visit completion risk
constraints.description: A visit of the risk priority or higher ends within the risk margin of its shift's end; costs the seconds inside the margin.

constraints.name: Prefer scheduling optional visits
constraints.description: An optional visit is unplanned; costs its priority weight.

constraints.name: Require scheduling mandatory visits
constraints.description: A mandatory visit is unplanned; costs its priority weight.

constraints.name: Maximize profit
constraints.description: A planned visit earns its profit; rewards the cents.

constraints.name: Keep a pinned visit's start service time
constraints.description: A pinned visit starts later than its kept start plus the allowed delay; costs 100 000 per second.

constraints.name: Keep a pinned visit's vehicle shift
constraints.description: A pinned visit is not on the shift it is pinned to; costs 10 000 000 000.

constraints.name: Minimize a pinned visit's start service time allowed delay
constraints.description: A pinned visit starts after its kept start, within the allowed delay; costs the seconds.

constraints.name: Minimize disruption on replanning
constraints.description: A replan moves a visit from the shift (100) or the vehicle (100) the input had it on, or shifts its start; costs those plus the seconds moved. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Max travel time per visit (hard)
constraints.description: The drive to a visit takes longer than its shift allows per visit; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Minimize waiting time
constraints.description: A technician waits before starting a visit; costs the seconds. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Prefer grouping co-located visits
constraints.description: Two consecutive items of a route are at the same place (within the co-location radius); rewards one per pair. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Prefer grouping visits in the same consecutive group
constraints.description: Two consecutive visits of a route share a preferred consecutive group; rewards one per pair. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Prefer moving towards end location
constraints.description: A drive after the first visit takes the technician farther from the shift's end location; costs the meters farther. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Require reachable visits
constraints.description: No road leads to a visit from the place before it; costs one hour per visit.

constraints.name: Latest SLA end time
constraints.description: A visit ends after its latest SLA end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Prefer scheduling optional visits with tighter SLA
constraints.description: An optional visit with an SLA is unplanned; costs more the tighter its SLA. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Prefer scheduling visits with tight SLAs earlier
constraints.description: A visit with an SLA ends late within the time its SLA leaves; costs the share of that time used, in thousandths.

constraints.name: Require scheduling mandatory visits with tighter SLA
constraints.description: A mandatory visit with an SLA is unplanned; costs more the tighter its SLA. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Minimize scheduling vehicles with unnecessary skill levels
constraints.description: The technician holds skills above the level a visit needs; costs its service seconds times the levels above.

constraints.name: Require skills
constraints.description: The technician lacks a skill a visit needs, or holds it below the level; costs one hour per skill and level short.

constraints.name: Minimize scheduling visits outside the preferred area
constraints.description: A visit lies outside the technician's preferred area; costs one per visit.

constraints.name: No visits outside coverage area
constraints.description: A visit lies outside the technician's coverage area; costs one hour per visit.

constraints.name: Maximize technician rating
constraints.description: A visit is served by a rated technician; rewards the rating times the service seconds. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Preferred visit time window
constraints.description: A visit's service falls outside its preferred time windows; costs the seconds outside.

constraints.name: Require service max end time
constraints.description: A visit's service ends after its window's latest end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Require service max start time
constraints.description: A visit's service starts after its window's latest start; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Prefer visit vehicle match preferred vehicles
constraints.description: A visit is served by a vehicle it prefers; rewards the preference weight times the service seconds.

constraints.name: Require tags
constraints.description: The shift serving a visit lacks tags it needs; costs one hour per tag.

constraints.name: Require visit vehicle match required vehicles
constraints.description: A visit is served by a vehicle it does not list among its required vehicles; costs one hour.

constraints.name: Require visit vehicle not match prohibited vehicles
constraints.description: A visit is served by a vehicle it prohibits; costs one hour.

constraints.name: Require parts in stock
constraints.description: A visit needs parts its shift's stock no longer holds when it is served, its earlier visits having used them; costs one hour per unit short.

constraints.name: No loops allowed
constraints.description: A visit cannot be timed: it waits on a visit planned after it, directly or through a joint visit; costs its service seconds plus one hour.

constraints.name: Balance movable and non-movable visits
constraints.description: Movable visits take more of a shift's working time than its threshold allows; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Max shift service duration (hard)
constraints.description: A shift's service exceeds its hard maximum; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Max shift service duration (soft)
constraints.description: A shift's service exceeds its preferred maximum; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Max shift travel time (hard)
constraints.description: A shift's travel exceeds its hard maximum; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Max shift travel time (soft)
constraints.description: A shift's travel exceeds its preferred maximum; costs the seconds over.

constraints.name: Max visits per shift (hard)
constraints.description: A shift serves more visits than its hard maximum; costs one hour per visit over.

constraints.name: Max visits per shift (soft)
constraints.description: A shift serves more visits than its preferred maximum; costs one per visit over.

constraints.name: Minimize travel distance
constraints.description: Driving distance of a shift that serves visits, start to end; costs the meters. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Minimize travel time
constraints.description: Driving time of a shift that serves visits, start to end; costs the seconds.

constraints.name: Penalize inactive shift travel distance
constraints.description: Driving distance of a shift that serves no visit, to its breaks and home; costs the meters. Off unless weighted.

constraints.name: Penalize inactive shift travel time
constraints.description: Driving time of a shift that serves no visit, to its breaks and home; costs the seconds.

constraints.name: Require reachable itineraries
constraints.description: A shift's route has a leg no road connects, start to end; costs one hour per leg.

constraints.name: Avoid overnight stay in local area
constraints.description: A linked shift keeps the technician out overnight between two visits both within reach of home; costs ten times the highest mandatory priority weight.

constraints.name: Max last visit departure time (hard)
constraints.description: A shift leaves its last visit after the latest departure; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Max last visit departure time (soft)
constraints.description: A shift leaves its last visit after the preferred departure; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Max shift end time (hard)
constraints.description: A shift reaches its end location after its latest end; costs the seconds late.

constraints.name: Max shift end time (soft)
constraints.description: A shift reaches its end location after its preferred end; costs the seconds of overtime.

constraints.name: Minimize shift costs
constraints.description: A shift that serves visits costs its fixed cost and its rates over its working time; costs the cents.

constraints.name: Require no mutually exclusive visits assigned
constraints.description: Two visits that exclude each other are both planned; costs one hour per pair.

constraints.name: Require shared tools free
constraints.description: A visit starts before a shared tool it needs is free and brought over from the visit that used it last; costs the seconds it waits.

constraints.name: Require visit dependency dependent assigned
constraints.description: A visit is planned while a visit that depends on it is not; costs the dependent's service seconds plus one hour.

constraints.name: No semi-assigned visit groups
constraints.description: Some visits of a multi-vehicle group are planned and others are not; costs the service seconds of each unplanned one plus one hour.

constraints.name: Excludes shifts
constraints.description: A linked shift and one of its component shifts both serve visits; costs one hour per visit on the component.

constraints.name: Balance time utilization
constraints.description: Technicians' utilization (worked over available time, history included) differs; costs the squares of each technician's utilization in ten-thousandths, divided by ten thousand.
